title: Plan O: AI Digital-Human Live Streaming
summary: Platform & compliance → avatar → script → smart interaction → studio setup → data optimization
scenario: Best for teams that want 24/7 streaming, batch avatar selling or brand live rooms without a human always on camera.

steps.title: Platform and compliance check
steps.detail: Confirm the target platform's requirements for digital-human streams (some require a visible AI label) and category licenses; read the rules first to avoid a ban.
steps.tips: Compliance is the first gate; missing AI labels, bait copy and prohibited goods are the top ban triggers.

steps.title: Avatar
steps.detail: Pick a preset avatar or clone a real presenter; the avatar should match the brand/goods vibe, with natural motion and lip sync.
steps.tips: Lip sync follows punctuation — normalize the script's punctuation before feeding the system.

steps.title: Script
steps.detail: Write live-sell copy (open with a hook, product explain, upsell, Q&A) in loop segments so the avatar can keep talking; prepare standard answers for frequent questions.
steps.tips: Design copy in 3-5 minute loops so you can adjust nodes for stock and price live.

steps.title: Smart interaction
steps.detail: Wire comment auto-reply: FAQ copy for common questions, fallback or human handoff for complex ones; set banned-word interception.
steps.tips: Interaction keeps people in the room; comment response speed matters more than fancy copy.

steps.title: Studio setup
steps.detail: Configure encoding, background, overlays, product shelf and coupons; test audio-video sync and latency with a 10-minute trial stream.
steps.tips: Trial at low traffic for an hour before scaling ad spend; don't burn budget on day one.

steps.title: Data optimization
steps.detail: Watch entry rate, dwell, engagement and conversion; feed metrics to the AI to review copy and pacing, then iterate the next session.
steps.tips: The bottleneck is usually script and interaction, not the avatar; A/B test copy variants.

pitfalls.title: Platform review and bans
pitfalls.detail: Digital-human streams must follow platform AI rules; unlabeled AI, bait copy and prohibited categories all risk bans.

pitfalls.title: Stiff looping copy
pitfalls.detail: Viewers see through an obvious loop instantly; keep iterating copy loops and interaction design off the data.

pitfalls.title: Interaction falling behind
pitfalls.detail: Unanswered comments bleed the audience; auto-reply plus fallback and human handoff for complex ones.

pitfalls.title: Out-of-sync lips and audio
pitfalls.detail: Mismatched lips feel terrible; normalize script punctuation and audio before going live.
